answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. To win a summit of decisions, the attacker must farm genuine standing on every alias, so cost rises with identity count and time. Think of a ripple for stability, a jetty for surprise, a inlet for peace — three qualities no Sybil can counterfeit in quantity.
